feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 7 October 2026 4:13pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 07 October 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the North Sea and high pressure to the southwest of Ireland.


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6, backing west or northwest 3 or 4 tomorrow morning, backing west or southwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Showers soon becoming isolated. Rain arriving from the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, backing south or southwest 5 to 7 through the evening, veering west or southwest 5 or 6 overnight into Friday, veering west later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Rain, heavy at times, clearing to showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.
